mentions.name: NomNominees
mentions.description: A simple webapp that tracks James Beard, Great American Beer Festival, Festival of Barrel Aged Beers, and other food and drink awards. It is used to find places to check out while traveling, with clusters on a map that reveal neighborhoods worth visiting.
mentions.source_excerpt: NomNominees is simple webapp that tracks James Beard, Great American Beer Festival, Festival of Barrel Aged Beers, and other awards. I use it when I'm traveling to find places to check out. Even just a cluster on a map shows me neighborhoods I might want to check out.
